space.name: env_layout_18
space.notes: T-K part 1, step 5's room, for the planning cases with a working robot: env_layout_17 with three objects the robot alone uses, the human's side unchanged (Hadi's ruling of 4 October 2026, option (b); it serves KT3's 'on env_layout_17'; step 5's set: analysis/kitting/mpb/tk/README.md). kitting_table_1 (440, -450), the robot's table in the south-east corner; shelf_5 (-470, -400) on the west wall, whose carry to kitting_table_1 runs along the south wall and passes 4 cm from where the human stands at shelf_4 (148, -438) and turns north; shelf_6 (480, -60) on the east wall between coffee_machine_0 and shelf_2, whose carry to kitting_table_1 passes where the human stands at the coffee machine (460, -253). With its own table no robot delivery ends at kitting_table_0, and the robot's routes cross the human's walks away from it. None of the three lies on a walk of the human from kitting_table_0 or on its straight continuation (the fallback projection's cut is env_layout_17's): kitting_table_1 is 158 cm from the walk from the coffee machine to shelf_4 and beyond shelf_4's arrival disc on the walk east from the A/C switch; shelf_6 is 146 cm east of the walk to the coffee machine. No assigned task of the human names them, so the human's hypotheses are env_layout_17's. Sizes are for drawing only.

Landmark (T-C1): the exit walk's target; a place for the human's script only; no task binds it. 50 cm in from both walls. From kitting_table_0 its bearing (0.0 deg, along the north wall) is 34.0 deg from the nearest target's (shelf_2); (450, -450) would be 6.6 deg from the coffee machine's. From the coffee machine the walk here passes through shelf_2's footprint, from shelf_4 27 cm from it.
The robot's table, the south-east corner; used by no task of the human.

A robot shelf on the east wall between coffee_machine_0 and shelf_2; its carry to kitting_table_1 passes the human's point at the coffee machine.
